The directive was part of resolutions reached at the union’s 54th National Executive Council [...]
inputs.modified_text: SSANU has given the federal government one month to conclude the long-delayed renegotiation of the 2009 agreement with non-teaching university unions, warning that it will begin an indefinite nationwide strike if its demands are not met. The ultimatum was among the resolutions reached at the union’s 54th National Executive Council meeting.
